# Train Distance Calculation

**Given information from the problem:**
- Speed = 60 km/h
- Time = 2.5 hours
- Unknown: Distance

## Formula used:

$$\text{Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time}$$

## Calculation:

$$\text{Distance} = 60 \text{ km/h} \times 2.5 \text{ h} = 150 \text{ km}$$

## Answer:

The train travels **150 kilometres**.
